_meta.description: Payment and OrderLine — generic related objects for attaching payments (deposits/disbursements/reclaims) and line items to any order-like object. NOT currently populated by the abstract-order-primitive fold (FoldIntoOrder keeps each type's amounts on the Order.subsidie/purchase/engagement field group directly, per the shipped design in zz-order-primitive.json) — these remain available for a future related-object refactor (e.g. a Payments widget) without being claimed as wired today.

Payment.title: Payment
Payment.description: A payment related to an Order (or invoice). Generalises the booking DepositPayment and the grant disbursement/reclaim amounts so the order detail can render a Payments widget instead of carrying amount fields. Deposits, installments, grant disbursements and reclaims are all Payment rows.

orderId.description: The Order this payment belongs to.
orderId.title: Order ID

paymentType.description: deposit (booking) / installment / disbursement (grant uitbetaald) / reclaim (grant teruggevorderd) / final / refund.
paymentType.title: Payment Type

linkedInvoiceId.description: Invoice this payment settles, if any.
linkedInvoiceId.title: Linked Invoice ID

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a Payment is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp (REQ-AT-001).

OrderLine.title: Order Line
OrderLine.description: A line on an Order — the unified successor of QuoteLine / SalesOrderLine. Related object, not an inline array, so lines are queryable + reusable across order types.

orderId.description: The Order this line belongs to.
orderId.title: Order ID

lineNumber.title: Line Number
lineNumber.description: The count or quantity of li.

discount.title: Discount
discount.description: The count or quantity of dis.

vatRate.title: BTW Rate
vatRate.description: The btw rate as a numeric value.

lineAmount.title: Line Amount
lineAmount.description: The line amount as a numeric value.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a Order Line is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp (REQ-AT-001).
